reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-09-04 against Lorenzo's issuer launch publication dated 2025-07-21. The publication identifies sUSD1+ as a non-rebasing fund share in USD1+ OTF, accepts USD1, USDT, and USDC deposits, and combines RWA, CeFi quantitative, and DeFi strategies before settling redemptions in WLFI USD1. The BSC proxy underlying() read at block 0x6b4e24 during the 2026-07-28 review points to USD1, but that settlement and contract reference does not establish that 100% of the strategy portfolio is USD1. The issuer publishes no weights for the accepted inputs or strategy sleeves and no reconciled custody inventory, so this portfolio cannot be represented as a single tracked-parent reserve link.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Lorenzo USD1+ OTF issuer launch publication dated 2025-07-21 and companion OTF guide; BSC underlying() call at block 0x6b4e24; Phemex Academy overview updated 2026-07-20
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The 100% strategy portfolio is not split among accepted USD1, USDT, and USDC deposits or the RWA, CeFi quantitative, and DeFi positions; no single-parent USD1 share is established. Under owner ruling D26 reviewed on 2026-10-01, the USD1 brand and settlement relationship do not support favorable single-parent inheritance until a measured USD1 claim is proven.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The OTF model is on-chain fundraising, off-chain execution, on-chain settlement: deposited funds leave the BNB Chain vault into strategy execution, and Lorenzo's own disclaimer states it 'does not manage user funds and is not responsible for the performance of any underlying strategy'. Who holds strategy assets off-chain (custodians, prime brokers, exchanges), whether accounts are segregated, and what insolvency treatment applies are all undisclosed, so segregation is unknown and no bankruptcy-remoteness structure is documented (recorded as none). Active deployment of vault assets into off-chain strategies is the disclosed design, recorded as permitted rehypothecation of the reserve. The prior June 2026 statement that the BSC implementation and upgrade authority were unresolved is superseded by the separate Mint Authority review: pinned 2026-10-01 reads identify implementation 0x972c27ee69b19d7648cef365700c22713a9a31fd, manager 0x507ec48ef26919a205a9f3b8aaf69532e20c0987 and the 2-of-3 Safe holding BOSS_ROLE, MANAGER_ROLE and CREATE_VAULT_ROLE. The March 2026 redemption guide now states a normal 3-6 day NAV settlement cycle, with possible extensions for large withdrawals or network congestion; the old 7-day minimum plus biweekly timing is not the current disclosed cadence.
